relevance_note: Longitudinal iNTD registry study of SSADHD that gives individual-level clinical and ALDH5A1 variant data (e.g. 'One patient (SSADH\_21) had a severe phenotype with developmental regression at the age of 9 months in the context of an infection.').
method_note: Extraction of the converted full text only; the file contains no 'Supplementary material' section, so Table S1 and Table S2 (referenced throughout) are unavailable and nothing was taken from them. The paper states 31 patients with SSADHD, but only 13 are named individually (SSADHD_02, _06, _09, _10, _14, _19, _20, _21, _22, _25, _28, _29, _31); the remaining patients are described only at group level, so no rows were created for them and their number is captured by publications.n_patients_reported and publications.cohort_size_as_stated. Table 1 is scrambled by the conversion: cells are split into fragments that are interleaved across columns, the Pat_ID row holds two labels in one cell ('SSADHD_20 SSADHD_21'), and several cells stack multiple values; following v6/D-31 no value was assigned to any person from Table 1 (so, for example, the brain-MRI and movement-disorder entries of SSADHD_10, _19, _25, _29 and _31 were not used). Table 2 has no patient identifiers (it is per variant); its column 11 is 'NM_001080.3: c.1226G>A' / 'Gly409Asp' (column alignment verified by the internal consistency of the p.His180Tyr column with the text 'a high enzymatic activity'), and the experimental enzyme activity of that column was recorded for SSADHD_21's variant. The sentence 'There was one further patient with one affected sibling who was not enrolled in the iNTD registry study.' is ambiguous (neither person gets a label and it is unclear who was enrolled), so no rows were created for them. The previously published SUDEP cases of the Discussion (refs 6,43) are not described as individuals and their variants are printed only as an unmatched list, so no rows were created. The 'older brother' of SSADHD_21 is included as a relative; he may be one of the 31 registered patients, so he may be double-counted. Spans are copied with the file's HTML entities ('>') and escaped underscores ('\_'). The cohort statement 'No sleeping problems and epileptic seizures were observed during follow-up visits in three individuals who were homozygous for the NM_001080.3:c.1226G>A, p.Gly409Asp variant' names no individual (six individuals are homozygous), so it was not used for anyone. Variant fields for SSADHD_21 come from sentences that name this exact variant (sections 3.5, 3.7 and Table 2), which D-29 allows, although those sentences are cohort-level in tone. The checklist has no item for developmental delay or regression, so the developmental problems of SSADHD_02 and SSADHD_21 appear only in phenotypic_features. cohort_size_as_stated = 32 (31 patients with SSADHD plus the one patient with GABA-T deficiency; the 429 individuals enrolled in the iNTD registry are not this study's patient group). cites_prior_report_of_same_patients = true because the paper describes its group as '27 unpublished cases' out of 31.
